project: Belirsizlik Altında Cevap Vermekten Kaçınan Yapay Zekâ
notes: An empty registry is not evidence of zero observed model errors or zero eligible upstream bugs.
Only independently validated, unexposed cases may be marked accepted_for_confirmatory=true.
Previously opened feasibility/smoke cases are permanently excluded.
No model inference has been performed for this study.
An accepted case must explicitly document buggy_test_outcome=target_failure_reproduced and fixed_test_outcome=target_test_passed; unrelated environment/setup failures do not qualify.
For every accepted case, runtime_python_version must exactly equal metadata_python_version; the runtime fingerprint and both test logs require SHA-256 values and artifact references.
Acceptance also requires test_pair_verified=true and evidence_levels_reviewed=true, in addition to license, leakage, prior-exposure, and two-independent-reviewer gates.
